data.title: 粉色针织衫下的小声提醒
data.location: 堆着蓝色收纳箱的公寓杂物间
data.lighting: 半掩房门透入的柔和侧光
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, dusty rose loose mohair knit sweater, dark grey shorts, standing beside stacked blue storage boxes, leaning slightly closer, one hand gesturing softly in quiet reminder, slight blush, earnest golden eyes looking at viewer, apartment storage nook, door light from side casting gentle highlights on knit texture and black hair, dutch angle, medium close-up
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the stacked blue storage bins in her soft pink knit sweater, she leans slightly closer with a hushed reminder and a faint tint of pink on her cheeks. Soft daylight from the ajar door highlights her knit sleeves and earnest amber eyes.
data.promptProse: Shot in a gently tilted horizontal event-CG close-up beside stacked blue storage containers in a quiet apartment nook, Shiki Natsume wears a soft dusty-rose knit sweater and dark lounge shorts. Leaning slightly toward the viewer with one hand raised in a quiet, measured reminder, she keeps her composure even as a delicate blush warms her cheeks under soft directional daylight filtering in through the open doorway.
data.story: 在堆满蓝色收纳箱的窄小储物间里，换上藕粉针织衫的夏目微微倾身，把声音压得很低地提醒你注意细节，面颊却悄悄沾了一点不自在的薄红。
